PCY-LZP-PLATFORM-GITOPS-ADMINISTRATION.name: pcy-lzp-platform-gitops-administration
PCY-LZP-PLATFORM-GITOPS-ADMINISTRATION.description: Policy that allows grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins groups to manage the resources in the Landing Zone Production Environment, Global Shared GitOps Platform compartment.
statements: allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read all-resources in tenancy
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage groups in tenancy where all {target.group.name != 'Administrators'}
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use network-security-groups in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage database-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage autonomous-database-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage alarms in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage metrics in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage cloudevents-rules in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage logging-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage instance-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops

allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage volume-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops where all{request.permission != 'VOLUME_BACKUP_DELETE', request.permission != 'VOLUME_DELETE', request.permission != 'BOOT_VOLUME_BACKUP_DELETE'}

allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage object-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops where all{request.permission != 'OBJECT_DELETE', request.permission != 'BUCKET_DELETE'}

allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage file-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops where all{request.permission != 'FILE_SYSTEM_DELETE', request.permission != 'MOUNT_TARGET_DELETE', request.permission != 'EXPORT_SET_DELETE', request.permission != 'FILE_SYSTEM_DELETE_SNAPSHOT', request.permission != 'FILE_SYSTEM_NFSv3_UNEXPORT'}
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage orm-stacks in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage orm-jobs in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage orm-config-source-providers in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read audit-events in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read work-requests in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage bastion-session in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage data-safe-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read instance-agent-plugins in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use vnics in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage keys in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use key-delegate in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage secret-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage repos in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-platform:cmp-lzp-platform-gitops
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read virtual-network-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-network
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use subnets in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-network
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use vnics in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-network
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use network-security-groups in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-network
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage private-ips in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-network
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read ons-topics in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use vaults in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use vss-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to use bastion in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to manage bastion-session in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
allow group grp-lzp-platform-gitops-admins to read logging-family in compartment cmp-landingzone-p:cmp-lzp-security
